name: state3
description: External validated task state for long-horizon coding work: the agent patches a compact state instead of relying on the transcript, so progress survives compaction and restarts (arXiv:2608.26263).

settings.name: state3 home
settings.description: Absolute path to the state3 repository that contains dist/mcp/server.js. Needed when this extension is installed outside that repository.

settings.name: state directory
settings.description: Absolute path of the .state3 directory to use. Set it when you start qwen outside the project: the server and the hooks otherwise take qwen's startup directory.

settings.name: supervised projects
settings.description: Additional .state3 roots the tools may address by name, as "name=dir;name2=dir2" or a JSON object of the same. Only roots declared here are reachable through the project argument, so a session can read and patch the task of a worker in another project without ever reaching an arbitrary directory. The hooks inject the active task of each declared root.

settings.name: subagent orientation
settings.description: Set to "off" to inject nothing on SubagentStart. By default a delegated subagent, which starts with no transcript, receives a few lines of orientation — the task, its goal, the step in flight, the next action and its risk — instead of the whole state. There is no "full" mode on purpose: the complete Σ and the procedure of its skill come from task_show.

hooks.name: state3-precompact-state
hooks.statusMessage: Adding state3 task state to the compaction context

hooks.statusMessage: Orienting the subagent in the task state
